title: MUFRADAT
summary: MUFRADAT As in most forms of art, a mastery of technique is essential. Just as many artists learn to draw by using standarized sketchbooks, the calligrapher learns by using an album of mufradat exercises to practice all the possible combinations of Arabic letters.
